quotes.quote: Hydrate, nourish, and repair your hair with OLAPLEX hair treatment and styling products. Shop all moisture masks, serums, shampoos and conditioners, and other hair repair products.

Repair bonds with OLAPLEX Bond Building Technology® for stronger hair. Incorporate OLAPLEX Nᴼ.0 Intensive Bond Building Treatment, followed by Nᴼ.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment, the new pre-shampoo treatment that’s formulated to protect and repair hair in just 3 minutes. It immediately revives all 5 key signs of hair health: strength, smoothness, softness, shine, and shape. Try a hair mask with patented OLAPLEX Bond Building Technology™ like the ￼ Weightless Nourishing Mask or the Rich Hydration Mask. Reach for the Weightless Nourishing Mask if you have fine to medium hair, or try the Rich Hydration Mask if you have medium to thick hair.
